scores.rationale: The candidate implementation was cut short mid-task, leaving `.lore/dod.md` in the repository and two of its four facets incomplete. In `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, `import Ajv from 'ajv'` (instead of `import {Ajv} from 'ajv'`) causes a TypeScript/ESM compilation error (`new Ajv(...)` is not constructable under NodeNext module resolution), and dynamic schemas from function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` are recompiled on every call without caching by schema object (`WeakMap`) and are also prematurely compiled at `register` time. The candidate misses most required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` (extra property pass-through, dynamic schema updates, static compilation count, unknown tool throw) and the test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. Finally, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were made, and `CHANGELOG.md` is incomplete.
